title: Editor Local Loopback Dev Runner

expectedOutput: Editor commit a007817b0f21de758e93a7c0b63873ca0414d5a7 adds npm scripts `dev:local-loopback` and `dev:local-loopback:smoke`, plus `scripts/run-local-loopback-dev.mjs`, so one command can start live Backend mode for local development while Core remains dependency-only.
